_doc: Source of truth for design tokens. Every color role needs a value AND a source (logo, signage, existing CSS, brand guide). Render with: node scripts/ds.js tokens <project> --format css|tailwind

bg.source: Shipped site CSS (src/layouts/Base.astro --paper), retained in this redesign: a warm off-white that sits beside the white field of the logo and van without competing with it

surface.source: White field of public/images/logo-full.png and the white van body in public/images/van/van-side.jpg

text.source: Charcoal sampled from public/images/logo-full.png (dominant colour, 48.7% of opaque pixels: #313131)

text-muted.source: Logo charcoal #313131 lightened until it passed 4.5:1 on bg and surface (darkened-for-contrast rule applied in reverse); replaces the shipped slate greys --ink-soft #4b5563 / --ink-muted #6b7280

action.source: Red sampled from public/images/logo-full.png (24.0% of opaque pixels: #d32b2c). Matches the shipped --red #d32f2f within 2 RGB steps, so customers still recognise it

action-text.source: White lettering on the red of the logo and van decal

action-hover.source: Logo red #D32B2C darkened for the hover/pressed state

ink-on-dark.source: White on the charcoal field, as the logo's 'S. MEREDITH' wordmark band reverses

dark.source: Logo charcoal; used for the footer and the phone button so the page has one dark colour, the logo's

star.source: Shipped review-star gold (--gold #c2902c) darkened to pass 3:1 against bg for non-text use

border.source: Shipped --paper-3 #E7E4DC darkened so form-field and divider edges are visible (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast is handled by the field border width plus focus ring)

focus.source: Logo charcoal used as a 3 px outline with a 2 px offset; 3:1 or better against bg, surface and the red buttons' surrounding bg

tint.source: Logo red #D32B2C at 10% over bg #FAF9F6; used only where colour carries information (emergency notice, form error summary), never as decoration

control.source: Logo charcoal #313131 mixed with white until the form-control border passes 3:1 on both surface and bg (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast); the shipped hairline borders were about 1.4:1

night.source: Logo charcoal #313131 darkened for the dark hero surfaces (options 1, 3, 5: #121212-#1B1B1B variants); text on it is white (17.9:1)

night-blue.source: Blue-hour shadow tone sampled from the van photo (public/images/van/van-side.jpg), used only behind hero option 2

call-green.source: The familiar phone-answer green, used only on the call illustration and call banner in hero option 1 (darkened to #1E9E4C behind the white handset icon)

display.name: Barlow Condensed
display.stack: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow Condensed Fallback', 'Arial Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', Impact, sans-serif
display.source: @fontsource/barlow-condensed (npm), latin subset, weight 700 only (22 KB). Chosen as the closest open-licence match to the heavy condensed gothic of the 'S. MEREDITH' wordmark in logo-full.png; the logo's own typeface is unknown, so this is a visual echo, not the logo font. A local fallback scaled to 68% (src/styles/fonts.css) keeps line breaks identical if the face arrives after first paint (no layout shift)
display.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (commercial use and self-hosting permitted)

body.name: Inter Variable
body.source: Shipped site font (src/styles/fonts.css), retained: one 48 KB latin variable file already preloaded and measured. Replacing it would add load time for no visible gain, so the display face carries the brand and Inter carries plain reading and form text
body.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (commercial use and self-hosting permitted)

lettering.name: Arial (system)
lettering.source: Echo of the bold italic bullet list painted on Shane's van (public/images/van/van-side.jpg; transcription assets/refs/van-side-list.txt). The van lettering face is unknown; a system Arial/Helvetica bold italic is the closest common match and downloads nothing. Used only in hero option 4 (review, not live).
lettering.license: System font: not shipped or self-hosted by the site, so no web-font licence applies

motion.justification: Home hero only (Incoming call, chosen by Irving 2026-10-10). Starts when the phone is on screen, rings about 2.5 s, connects, texts arrive by about 4.1 s, then still. CSS plus a 15-line arming script; text and buttons never move; static answered call with reduced motion or without JavaScript. Every other page stays motion-free.
